metadata.case_name: WONG CHUN KIN v. CARITAS HONG KONG

plaintiff.occupation_after: welfare worker/trainer at Po Leung Kuk

injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of lumbar spine

injuries.description: slight posterior prolapse of the T11/12 disc and early dehydration of the lumbar and lower thoracic discs
injuries.body_part: T11/12 disc; lumbar and lower thoracic discs
source: there was a slight posterior prolapse of the T11/12 disc and early dehydration of the lumbar and lower thoracic discs detected but no significant nerve impingement.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: mild disc desiccation at T11/12 & T12/L1; mild left lateral disc protrusion at L5/S1; lower thoracic spine mild left paracentral disc protrusion
injuries.body_part: lower thoracic and lumbar spine (T11/12, T12/L1, L5/S1)
source: normal lumbar alignment; mild disc desiccation at T11/12 & T12/L1; L5/S1. There is mild left lateral disc protrusion with no significant compression; and lower thoracic spine showed mild left paracentral disc protrusion.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: left calf and left foot weakness and tremor
unable to sleep in the supine position or sleep on his left side
condition deteriorates when he stands or walks for a long period of time
unable to carry weight of 5 kg for 10 minutes
refrain from participating in sports and activities such as playing basketball, cycling, jogging and hiking

treatments_received: A&E attendance and outpatient follow-up at Tseung Kwan O Hospital (TKOH) and general outpatient clinics
physiotherapy (private clinic: 4 sessions between 8 December 2014 to 23 January 2015; PD: 28 sessions from 6 July 2015 to 9 March 2016; 18 sessions in 30 weeks noted on 18 May 2017)
referral to orthopaedic and traumatology department and physiotherapy department of TKOH

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: has to refrain from participating in such sports and activities like before.
